title: docs(qa): re-point three stale checklist lines (dataset editor, zh-CN template writes, built-in nav walk)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #30129

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：更新了 4 个测试清单条目里过时的准备步骤和操作步骤：仪表盘条目不再说"Studio 没有数据集编辑器"；两个邮件模板条目改为把中文（zh-CN）版本写进 showcase 的定制包；内置应用导航条目更新了 Setup 的入口数，并加了一步：窄窗口下先展开侧边栏。
- 为什么改：照旧步骤跑，中文模板的写入会被 403 拒绝，后面的测试步骤就跑不下去；入口数和侧边栏的写法也会让测试人员把正常行为误判为失败。中文模板的新写法我在 base 上启动 showcase 实测过：能写入、能读回，也能按中文渲染发出邮件。
- 风险与回滚：只改了 docs/qa 下的 4 个清单 JSON，产品代码、种子数据和 showcase 都没动。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：integration-system.json 的 email-template-render 条目（fixtures.requires[2]，新的写入方式）；api-backend.json 的 meta-read-doors-v18 条目（fixtures.requires[1]）；platform-core.json 的 builtin-apps-nav-render 条目（steps[2] 和 steps[5]）。
- 两分钟验证：在分支上运行 `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，应输出 OK（16 areas, 360 items），退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

Each of the card's three lines was re-read at base `232d3bb5ef` before it was applied. None was already done at base, so all three are applied. Each edited item gets a revision bump and a history row with `ref` #30129.

- **Line 1: `studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` (rev 6 → 7), `fixtures.requires[2]`.** The "Studio has no dataset editor (expected: the Interfaces card read it no-entry)" parenthetical is removed. #29906 removed the same text from `interfaces-create-dialogs` and `report-authoring-options`, and this edit uses the same wording. The new text cites Studio's New dataset entry, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/datasetCreate.tsx` (`DatasetCreateEntry`, `engine.studio.interfaces.newDataset.*`). For a dashboard, the entry that matters is the one beside the widget inspector's dataset picker (`DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`). The text also names the New report dialog's entry. The fixture stays API-written, for a known shape.
- **Line 2: the zh-CN template writes, re-pointed with a recipe measured on a live showcase boot at base** (see Verification).
  - `integration-system.email-template-render` (rev 14 → 15), `fixtures.requires[2]`: the "same name, locale zh-CN" scratch copy is now a zh-CN member written into `com.example.showcase.custom`. The steps are `ensure-customization`, then `PUT …?package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `locale: 'zh-CN'` in the body and **no `overrides`**. To reset it: `DELETE …?package=com.example.showcase.custom&member=zh-CN`.
  - `api-backend.meta-read-doors-v18` (rev 4 → 5), `fixtures.requires[1]`: the same recipe replaces the bare PUT. `meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` already authors the member this way.
  - **The card's example recipe, `?package=….custom` with `overrides`, does not work for this member.** The base ships `en-US` only, so a declared override of a `zh-CN` member answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("ships no email_template named … with locale 'zh-CN'", `declared_package_ships_no_such_item`). A zh-CN member is the pair's own item, so the body carries no `overrides`.
- **Line 3: `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render` (rev 12 → 13), `steps[2]` and `steps[5]`.** Revision 7's "steps[2] and steps[5] corrected" row is from #24632 (2026-10-19). It fixes different findings, and comment 6600018008 on #27377 (W5-P0, QA run #29877, 2026-11-03) came after it. Both of the comment's findings were still stale at base:
  - `steps[5]`: Setup now serves 46 destinations to the admin and Account 8, not 50 and 8. Since QA run #28545's reading, Setup's Packaged automation page retired under ADR-0146 D11 (#28785; only `nav_packaged_actions` remains), and the unfiltered Packages entry moved to Studio (#29547). Both commits are ancestors of `589049b0` and not of `eeec88d1` (control: `8cb8c7f461` is an ancestor of `eeec88d1`, exit 0). The count was re-read live at base.
  - `steps[2]`: a window narrower than 1416 px (1280 px included) opens Setup and Account on the icon rail (`consoleSidebarRail.ts` `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_RAIL_BELOW_WIDTH`). The walk now presses the sidebar toggle before it expands the `expanded: false` groups. This was read from source, not driven live.

## Tests

This PR changes the checklist ledger only. No product code, test, seed or showcase file changes. `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` validates the ledger. Every edit was applied at text level. Each file was then re-parsed and compared item by item against the base, to prove that only the intended item changed and that its `revision` equals its last `history` row.

## Acceptance notes

- All three lines were re-read at base `232d3bb5ef`. None was already applied, so none is skipped.
- Line 2 differs from the card's suggested recipe in one way: no `overrides` for a member the base does not ship. Both the save-door refusal and the live send were measured.
- Added by the seat's call: `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix` (rev 6 → 7), `variants[35]` carried the same stale "dataset (Studio has no dataset editor)" parenthetical. It now names Studio's New dataset and why the row's keys still have no Studio control (commit `ecccdedfea`, report delta 6639164497).
- Out of scope, not edited: the package-less zh-CN PUT answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. Its sentence tells the caller to save into the pair "declaring overrides", and that write is refused 403 in turn. The docblock of `packagelessCloseSubject` (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`) says the opposite: an `email_template` member at a locale the base does not ship "stays open", and its package-less write is kept. Measured live; filed by the seat as #30168 (`domain:server`, `finding`).

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → `OK — 16 areas, 360 items (354 active, 1 planned)`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 16 commands at `f9530757f7`. All 16 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. This is a derived zero, because every line recorded an exit code.
- `origin/main` was merged once before opening (merge `f9530757f7`).

<details><summary>Line 2: live probe on a fresh showcase boot at base (pnpm dev -- --fresh, admin)</summary>

| # | Request | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `PUT /api/v1/meta/email_template/showcase_task_done_email` package-less, en-US body (control) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |
| 2 | same, body `locale: 'zh-CN'` (the ledger's old recipe) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |
| 3 | `GET …?member=zh-CN` | 404 |
| 4 | `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` | 201 `created: true, writable: true` |
| 5 | `PUT …?package=com.example.showcase.custom`, zh-CN body + `overrides: {package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn: '0.1.0'}` | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (ships no email_template … with locale 'zh-CN') |
| 6 | `PUT …?package=com.example.showcase.custom`, zh-CN body, no `overrides` | 200 `Saved customization overlay … state=active` |
| 7 | `GET …?member=zh-CN` / `?member=en-US` / no member | 200 zh-CN (`packageId: com.example.showcase.custom`) / 200 shipped en-US / 200 en-US |
| 8 | scratch `type: 'api'` flow, notify node `channels ['email']`, `template showcase_task_done_email`; admin `sys_user.locale` zh-CN; `POST /api/v1/automation/NAME/trigger` | 200; `sys_email` row `sent`, subject `✅ 任务完成:QA zh probe`, zh body |
| 9 | same with `sys_user.locale` en-US (control) | `sys_email` row `sent`, subject `✅ Task done: QA zh probe` |
| 10 | `DELETE …?package=com.example.showcase.custom&member=zh-CN`, then `GET …?member=zh-CN` / `?member=en-US` | 200 reset; 404; 200 shipped en-US |

</details>

<details><summary>Line 3: Setup / Account leaves on the same boot</summary>

`GET /api/v1/meta/app` → `showcase_app, setup, account`. `?id=setup` → 46 leaves (groups excluded), including `nav_packaged_actions` and no packaged-automation or Packages entry. `?id=account` → 8 leaves: `nav_account_profile nav_account_notifications nav_account_approvals nav_account_linked nav_account_sessions nav_account_api_keys nav_account_oauth_apps nav_connect_agent`. The server was stopped by its process group, and the `--fresh` home (`/tmp/objectstack-dev-…`) is gone.

</details>
